description: Agent Commitments: submit the commitments an agent marked done with their closure evidence: each closure with the commitment id, the commitment, the promisee, when it was marked done and by whom (the agent, the promisee or another party), whether the deliverable reached the promisee and when, the record of delivery such as a message id, a file link or a ticket, and whether, by whom and when the promisee acknowledged it. The signed report gives every closure with its delivery, its acknowledgement and its status as closed_with_evidence, undelivered, unevidenced, self_closed, acknowledged_by_other, marked_early or unconfirmed, and counts the deliveries with a record and the acknowledgements by the promisee, by another party or by no one, and names closures with no evidence: commitments marked done with nothing delivered, closed with no record of the delivery, and closed on the agent’s own word with no acknowledgement from the promisee; then acknowledgements from someone other than the promisee and commitments marked done before their delivery, with the fix for each. This closes the agent’s own promises with evidence: closing the loop on feedback received is wever_feedback-closure-check, and checking a delegate’s work against its brief before accepting it is wever_delegation-result-check. Verdict closure_unevidenced, closure_evidence_gaps, closure_evidence_unverified or commitments_closed_with_evidence. POST /api/commitment-closure-check. Reads only the recorded promises and records in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write; no promise is made, changed or closed and no promisee is contacted. Agent Commitments reads the promises an agent makes itself, from capture to closure: it is not delegation (assigning work and authority to another agent, the wever_delegation checks; a commitment is the agent’s own promise, whoever ends up doing the work), not coordination (how agents organize shared work, the wever_coordination checks), not reputation (the durable standing a track record earns, the wever_reputation checks; commitments are the individual promises that record is built from), not the loop on feedback received (wever_feedback-closure-check; this family closes the agent’s own promises) and not who answers for an outcome (wever_ownership-map-brief; this family tracks the promise itself). Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-commitments-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-commitments/.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.
